text:
emily.cs: Heads-up: Borealis acquired NorthArc; renewal for NorthArc seats is coming up 2025-07-15 and AP is asking to consolidate billing under Borealis. Potential blocker for renewal if we can't accept their existing PO.
mike.sales: FYI sales already ok with consolidation if price/term unchanged. They want a single invoice under Borealis LLC but NorthArc submitted PO # (pending) with vendor code NA-778.
rahul.legal: We can do a one-page entity-substitution addendum. Need full legal name + tax ID for Borealis and explicit acceptance language for an existing PO funneling to new entity. Keep it short.
sara.cs: I asked the customer for the Borealis legal name + tax id + AP contact. AP says they will sign only after invoice sample includes PO field and line-item mapping to account ids.
tara.enable: Note: NorthArc seats are scheduled for provisioning mid-June. If AP holds signing until invoice matches, onboarding could be delayed. We should aim to provide a sample invoice within 24 hours.
jordan.ops: For Dedicated customers, consolidation could change tenant/KMS mapping. If Borealis wants keys under their KMS, we'll need a migration window. Ops impact depends on whether they want a single tenant or just invoicing consolidated.
emily.cs: Action list: Rahul drafts addendum, Jordan mockups invoice template, Sara collects exact legal names + PO, Mike confirms pricing lock, Tara monitors onboarding timeline. Target: 48 hrs.
rahul.legal: Drafting addendum now. Proposed clause: "Redwood shall accept existing purchase orders issued to NorthArc LLC and apply them to Borealis LLC upon execution of this addendum; such acceptance does not modify pricing or service terms." Will post in shared drive.
sara.cs: Customer response: provided BOR-2024 vendor code and AP contact lena.ortiz@borealis.com. Signer: Lena Ortiz, VP Finance. No PO number yet; AP says they will issue PO once invoice sample shows PO field and vendor code.
mike.sales: Confirmed with finance: pricing/term unchanged; net30 is acceptable. Sales ok with addendum.
emily.cs: Sara, once PO shows up, open DocuSign using Rahul's addendum. Tag me to counter-sign. Jordan please attach the invoice PDF sample that includes fields: invoice number, billing entity name, tax id, customer account IDs, PO number, and per-seat breakdown.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope prepared (env_borealis_001). Signers: Lena Ortiz (external signer), Redwood CS (emily.cs). Link: https://docusign.example/env_borealis_001
jordan.ops: Uploaded invoice sample: sample_consolidated_invoice_Borealis.pdf (shows per-account lines and consolidated total). I left a note where KMS/tenant mapping would be referenced but not changed.
sara.cs: Sent envelope to Lena with invoice sample attached. Lena replied: "We can sign once PO# is present on the invoice and net30 retained." She asked if we can reflect the existing NorthArc account IDs on line items. I confirmed yes.
rahul.legal: Quick legal note: if PO issued to NorthArc is >90 days old we should ask finance about potential proration or credit memos. I'll flag credits if invoice dates mismatch.
emily.cs: Good point. Jordan, run a check on invoice date ranges to confirm no overlap in seats that would trigger credits.
jordan.ops: Ran a quick reconcile: NorthArc term ends 2025-07-31, Borealis wants consolidated invoicing starting 2025-07-01. If invoicing starts 7/1 we might need a short credit for the overlap month depending on billing cycle.
mike.sales: Customer insisted no price changes. Sales can accept a one-time credit memo if needed to reconcile prepaid seats, but prefer no credits.
sara.cs: Lena just sent a tentative PO number in chat: PO-BO-4592. She asked us to show that PO on the invoice before signing.
emily.cs: Sara, attach PO to DocuSign envelope (if envelope still open) or send an updated invoice PDF and new envelope. Rahul, once signed, do we need any additional signature from procurement/legal?
rahul.legal: One counter-sign from Redwood CS is sufficient for the addendum. If finance requires a credit memo we'll draft separately.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope updated (env_borealis_001) with attachment PO-BO-4592.pdf. Status: sent to Lena Ortiz.
sara.cs: Lena acknowledged and said finance will sign within 48 hours if invoice shows PO.
tara.enable: I'll flag the onboarding play to start provisioning on receipt of signed addendum + PO. If we don't have signed docs by 2025-06-10, we'll delay provisioning by one sprint.
emily.cs: Summary: Rahul drafting addendum (posted), Jordan produced invoice sample, Sara got BOR-2024 + PO-BO-4592, Mike confirmed pricing/net30, Tara owning provisioning threshold. Next check-in in 48 hours or sooner if signature lands. :thumbsup:
